age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

checks_failed.description: `credential:<issuer>:<credential_type>` (type in ledger hex) of each `unknown` credential; empty when every check answered

credentials.description: Each accepted credential looked up for the account, in the domain's order; empty for the owner

credential_id.description: Ledger entry index of a found credential, to pass in `credentials` of `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness`; null when it is missing or its read failed

status.description: `missing` (none on the ledger), `not_accepted` (the subject has not accepted it), `expired` (`Expiration` before the validated ledger close time), `valid`, or `unknown` (its read failed or its expiry could not be checked)

domain.description: The PermissionedDomain read from the validated ledger

accepted_credentials.description: Credentials the domain accepts, in the domain's order

credential_type_ascii.description: Readable text of `credential_type` when every byte is printable ASCII; else null

credential_id.description: Ledger entry index of the credential

expires_at.description: `Expiration` of the credential, ISO 8601 UTC; null without one

matched_credential.description: The first `valid` credential in the domain's order; null unless membership is by credential

membership.description: `owner`, `credential` (through a `valid` credential), or null when the verdict is not `eligible`

verdict.description: `eligible` for the owner or when any credential is `valid`; `unknown` when none is valid and any is `unknown`; else `not_eligible`

description: Is this account a member of this XRPL permissioned domain, as its owner or through an accepted, unexpired credential? When to use: Before trading in a permissioned order book (`/v1/xrpl/orderbook` or `/v1/xrpl/slippage` with `domain`): to check whether an account is a member of the domain, as its owner or through an accepted, unexpired credential, and which credential qualifies it. Prefer another tool: To check whether one payment can succeed now (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness`, whose `credentials` takes the `credential_id` values of this answer), or to read the permissioned order book itself (use `/v1/xrpl/orderbook` with `domain`). Example: xrpl_domain_eligibility {"domain_id":"DBABFD44A80DB623522628550B270FA5E2A845341E137530728E2E3699181A4E","account":"rcKV6taNcBAi8GxudZnMdFUPcH3Ls5TAv"} Paid: 0.02904 USDC or 0.0242 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.02 EUR-denominated units (approx 50 calls per bundle) or 0.024 USD-denominated units (approx 34 calls per bundle).

account.description: Account to check as a member of the domain: valid classic XRPL address (r..., checksum verified)

domain_id.description: PermissionedDomain id: 64 hexadecimal characters, either case
